1008.description: A step-up with a band around the thighs. It trains the glutes and quads.
instructions: Place a band around your thighs, just above your knees.
Stand facing a step or platform with your feet hip-width apart.
Step up onto the platform with your right foot, pushing through your heel.
Extend your left leg behind you, keeping it straight.
Lower your left foot back down to the ground.
Repeat with your left foot stepping up onto the platform.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将一条带子绕在大腿上，就在膝盖上方。
面向台阶或平台站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
用右脚踩上平台，用脚后跟推动。
将左腿伸到身后，保持伸直。
将左脚放回地面。
重复左脚踩上平台的动作。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。

1072.description: Dip between straps. It works the chest and triceps.
instructions: Support yourself on the straps with arms straight.
Lean slightly forward.
Lower until elbows reach 90 degrees.
Press back up.
Keep the straps steady.

1136.description: A one-leg squat holding the straps for support, building leg strength and balance.
instructions: Hold the handles and stand on one leg, other leg forward.
Sit your hips back and bend the knee.
Lower as far as you can control.
Keep your knee over your toes and chest tall.
Drive through the heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

1200.description: An overhead press helped by a quick leg dip and drive. It lets you handle heavier loads for the shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Hold the barbell at your upper chest with your elbows slightly in front of the bar.
Dip a few inches by bending your knees, keeping your torso upright.
Drive up through your legs and press the bar overhead.
Lock out with the bar over your mid foot, then lower it back to your chest.
Brace your core and avoid leaning back.

1264.description: A one-arm incline cable fly on an exercise ball. It trains the upper chest.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back against an incline bench.
Hold a cable handle in one hand with your arm extended and palm facing inward.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbow, slowly lower your arm out to the side until your hand is in line with your shoulder.
Pause for a moment, then squeeze your chest muscles to bring your arm back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地面上，背部靠在倾斜的长凳上。
一只手握住电缆手柄，手臂伸展，手掌朝内。
保持肘部轻微弯曲，慢慢地将手臂向一侧放低，直到手与肩膀在一条直线上。
暂停片刻，然后挤压胸部肌肉，使手臂回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1328.description: Lie face down on a bench and row two dumbbells up and out. It targets the rear shoulders and upper back without any body swing.
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing inwards.
Extend your arms straight down towards the floor, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Engaging your back muscles, lift the dumbbells up towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 脸朝下躺在平坦的长凳上，每只手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝内。
将手臂伸直向下伸向地板，肘部保持轻微弯曲。
调动背部肌肉，将哑铃举向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1392.description: A one-leg calf press on a leg press sled using only your toes. It trains each calf separately under a supported load.
instructions: Adjust the seat of the leg press machine so that your knees are slightly bent when your feet are on the sled.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet on the sled, shoulder-width apart.
Place your toes and the balls of your feet on the sled, keeping your heels off.
Push the sled forward by extending your ankles, keeping your knees slightly bent.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the sled back down by flexing your ankles.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整压腿机的座椅，使双脚踩在雪橇上时膝盖稍微弯曲。
坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚放在雪橇上，与肩同宽。
将脚趾和脚掌放在雪橇上，保持脚跟离开。
伸展脚踝，保持膝盖稍微弯曲，将雪橇向前推。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后通过弯曲脚踝慢慢将雪橇放回原处。
重复所需的重复次数。

1456.description: A standing barbell overhead press with a narrow grip. It hits the front delts and triceps and asks your core to keep you steady.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly closer than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell to shoulder height, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Press the barbell overhead, extending your arms fully.
Lower the barbell back to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，正手握住杠铃，双手距离略小于肩宽。
将杠铃举至肩膀高度，保持肘部靠近身体。
将杠铃推过头顶，充分伸展双臂。
将杠铃降低回肩部高度。
重复所需的重复次数。

1520.description: A clean that starts from the hang at the thighs. It trains the explosive hip drive and the catch.
instructions: Stand holding the bar at mid-thigh with a grip just outside your legs and a flat back.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it on your front shoulders in a squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.

1584.description: A deep squat followed by a big vertical jump with your arms reaching up. It builds explosive leg power.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down while swinging your arms back.
Explode upward and reach both arms overhead as you jump.
Extend your whole body like a rocket.
Land softly on bent knees and reset before the next jump.

1648.description: Alternating hammer curls while seated. The neutral grip trains the brachialis and forearms.
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your torso and arms extended down.
Keep your back straight and your elbows close to your torso.
Exhale and curl the dumbbell in your right hand towards your shoulder, keeping your upper arm stationary.
Continue to raise the dumbbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbell is at shoulder level.
Pause for a brief moment, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your left arm.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向躯干，手臂向下伸展。
保持背部挺直，肘部靠近躯干。
呼气，将右手的哑铃向肩膀弯曲，保持上臂静止。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
暂停片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
用左臂重复该动作。
继续交替手臂进行所需的重复次数。

1712.description: A partner-assisted stretch lying on your side for the inner thigh. It lengthens the adductors.
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs straight and stacked on top of each other.
Bend your bottom leg slightly for stability.
Place your top foot on a stable surface, such as a bench or step.
Keeping your top leg straight, slowly lower it towards the ground, feeling a stretch in your inner thigh.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Return to the starting position and repeat on the other side.
instructionsZh: 侧躺，双腿伸直并叠放在一起。
稍微弯曲下面的腿以保持稳定。
将上脚放在稳定的表面上，例如长凳或台阶上。
保持上腿伸直，慢慢将其降低到地面，感觉大腿内侧有拉伸感。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
返回起始位置并在另一侧重复。

1776.description: Lying face down, you lift one straight leg off the floor. It strengthens your glutes and hamstrings with a gentle load on the lower back.
instructions: Lie face down with your legs straight and your forehead on your hands.
Tighten your abs and glutes.
Raise one straight leg a few inches off the floor.
Pause briefly at the top without arching your lower back.
Lower under control and repeat, then switch legs.

1840.description: Stretches the front and side of the neck by combining a head tilt back with a turn.
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders down.
Turn your head slightly to one side.
Tilt your chin up and back until you feel a stretch along the front of your neck.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1904.description: A standing side lunge position that lengthens the inner thighs.
instructions: Stand with your feet wide apart, toes pointing slightly out.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee while the other leg stays straight, and feel the inner thigh stretch.
Keep your chest up and the straight leg's foot flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1968.description: Pulling the toes back against a wall to stretch the sole of the foot and the calf.
instructions: Stand facing a wall and place the toes of one foot on it with the heel on the floor.
Lean forward gently until you feel the stretch along the bottom of the foot and into the calf.
Keep your heel firmly on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2096.description: Gently bends the fingers down to stretch the tight tissue on the top of the hand and fingers. Handy after typing or gripping work.
instructions: Hold one arm out in front of you with the palm facing down.
Use your other hand to press the fingers of the extended hand gently downward.
Keep the elbow of the extended arm straight and the shoulders relaxed.
Stop at a mild pull, never at pain.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and repeat on the other hand.

2224.description: A leg press on a 45 degree sled that loads the thighs and hips while your back stays supported.
instructions: Sit in the seat with your back and head flat against the pad.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart in the middle of the platform.
Release the safety handles and lower the sled until your knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Keep your lower back pressed into the pad as you descend.
Push through your whole foot to extend your legs without locking your knees.
Lower under control and repeat.

2288.description: A machine gripper where you squeeze the handles closed. Strengthens the forearms and grip.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and grip the handles of the leverage machine.
Keep your back straight and your feet flat on the ground.
Exhale and squeeze the handles, contracting your forearms.
Hold the contraction for a second, then slowly release and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度并握住杠杆机的手柄。
保持背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
呼气并挤压手柄，收缩前臂。
保持收缩一秒钟，然后慢慢释放并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2352.description: A side-by-side form check for arm and body position during a biceps curl, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructions: Stand tall holding dumbbells at your sides with palms forward.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your elbows stay pinned at your sides and your torso does not swing.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

2544.description: A wide pulldown to the back of the neck that works the lats and upper back.
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station with your thighs secured.
Grab the bar with a wide overhand grip.
Lean forward slightly and pull the bar down behind your head to the base of your neck.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Control the bar back up.
Move gently and keep your neck neutral.

2736.description: A reverse grip lat pulldown on a machine. Builds the lats and biceps.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your knees under the pads and your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Sit upright with your chest out and shoulders back, maintaining a slight arch in your lower back.
Pull the handles down towards your chest, leading with your elbows and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly release the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度，将自己放在机器上，膝盖位于垫子下方，双脚平放在地面上。
正手握住手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
坐直，挺胸，肩膀向后，保持下背部轻微的拱形。
将手柄向下拉向胸部，用肘部引导并将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作底部暂停片刻，然后慢慢松开手柄回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2800.description: A seated alternate leg raise with a barbell across the thighs and hands on the bench. Works the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and hold a barbell across your thighs.
Place your hands on the sides of the bench for support.
Keeping your legs straight, lift one leg up as high as possible while keeping it parallel to the ground.
Lower the leg back down and repeat with the other leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，将杠铃放在大腿上。
将双手放在长凳两侧以获得支撑。
保持双腿伸直，将一条腿尽可能抬高，同时保持与地面平行。
将腿放回原位，然后换另一条腿重复此动作。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。

2864.description: A Pilates side bend from a seated or side-supported position that works the obliques and the sides of the trunk.
instructions: Sit tall on your side with your bottom hand pressed into the mat and your legs stacked.
Lift your hips so your body forms a long diagonal line.
Reach your top arm overhead and bend sideways over the supporting arm.
Lift back up to the long line while keeping your hips high.
Lower with control and repeat, then switch sides.

2928.description: A shrug done with the barbell locked out overhead. It targets the traps and helps with overhead stability.
instructions: Hold a barbell locked out overhead with a wide grip.
Keep your arms straight and your ribs down.
Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly without bending your elbows.

2992.description: A self-massage for the calves using a barbell to roll over tight spots.
instructions: Sit on the floor with one calf resting on a barbell.
Support yourself with your hands behind you.
Roll your calf slowly back and forth over the bar.
Pause on tender spots for a few breaths.
Switch to the other leg.

3120.description: A calf raise holding on for balance, so you can focus on the calves.
instructions: Stand holding a wall or rail for balance.
Place your feet hip-width apart.
Rise up on your toes as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze your calves.
Lower slowly.

3184.description: A barbell squat with bands hanging weights from the bar. The wobble forces you to stay stable.
instructions: Set up the bar with bands hanging kettlebells or weights from each end.
Rest the bar across your upper back and step out.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down with a braced core.
Drive up through your feet.
Use a lighter load and move slowly.

3248.description: A standing movement reaching down to touch your toes for a warm-up of the hamstrings and back.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward and reach toward your toes.
Let your head hang relaxed.
Rise slowly.
Repeat at a steady pace.

3312.description: A weighted muscle up performed with the added load on a bar. An advanced pull and dip that trains the lats, chest and triceps.
instructions: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Bend your elbows and pull your chest towards the bar, keeping your body straight.
Once your chest reaches the bar, push down with your hands and drive your elbows back, lifting your body above the bar.
Pause at the top of the movement, then slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先悬挂在引体向上杆上，手掌背向自己，双手之间的距离略大于肩宽。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨向下拉和向后拉。
弯曲肘部，将胸部拉向杠铃杆，保持身体挺直。
当你的胸部到达杠铃时，用手向下推并将肘部向后推，将身体提升到杠铃上方。
在动作的最高点暂停，然后慢慢降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3376.description: A jumping jack with rope waves added, so arms and legs both work hard.
instructions: Hold the rope ends with feet together.
Jump your feet apart while raising your arms and making waves.
Jump back to the start.
Keep your landings soft.
Keep a steady pace for the set time.

3440.description: A jump from a split stance onto a box, building leg power.
instructions: Stand in a lunge position facing a box.
Swing your arms and jump up.
Land with both feet softly on the box.
Stand tall.
Step down carefully.
Switch your front leg and repeat.

3504.description: A standing quad stretch with balance. It lengthens the front of the thigh and hips.
instructions: Stand tall, holding a wall for balance if needed.
Bend one knee and grab your ankle behind you.
Pull your heel toward your glutes with knees together.
Keep your hips tucked and your chest up.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and switch legs.

3568.description: Use a small ball under the buttock to ease tension in the piriformis and deep hip muscles.
instructions: Sit on the floor and place a ball under one buttock.
Cross that ankle over the opposite knee for more access.
Shift your weight to find a tender spot and stay there.
Breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds, then roll gently.
Switch sides.

3632.description: From a wide seated position, twist toward the right leg to stretch the inner thigh and torso.
instructions: Sit with legs spread wide and back tall.
Rotate your torso to the right.
Reach both hands toward your right foot.
Keep your hips grounded.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side if needed.

3696.description: A bent-over fly performed one arm at a time to target the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back, a dumbbell in each hand hanging down.
Raise one arm out to the side to shoulder height with a soft elbow.
Lower it slowly.
Repeat with the other arm, alternating.
Keep your torso still and your neck neutral.

3760.description: A second take on the seated machine crunch, curling forward against resistance. It trains the abs.
instructions: Sit on the leverage machine with your back against the pad and your feet secured under the footpads.
Place your hands on the handles or the sides of the seat for support.
Engage your abs and slowly crunch forward, bringing your chest towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your abs.
Slowly return to the starting position, allowing your back to round slightly.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在杠杆机上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚固定在脚垫下。
将手放在把手上或座椅两侧以获得支撑。
收紧腹肌，慢慢向前挺胸，使胸部靠近膝盖。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压腹肌。
慢慢回到起始位置，让背部稍微弯曲。
重复所需的重复次数。

3824.description: A push-up with your hands near your hips and your body leaning forward. It strongly loads shoulders and chest.
instructions: Start in a plank with your hands turned out beside your lower ribs.
Lean your shoulders forward beyond your hands.
Lower your chest with your elbows close to your body.
Press up while keeping the lean.
Keep your core braced.

3888.description: A one-armed dumbbell snatch, pulling the weight from the floor to overhead in one explosive movement. It trains the hips, legs and shoulders.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand with an overhand grip.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Lower the dumbbell towards the ground, keeping it close to your body.
Explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles, driving the dumbbell upwards in a straight line.
As the dumbbell reaches shoulder height, quickly rotate your hand and punch it overhead, fully extending your arm.
Catch the dumbbell overhead with a slight bend in your knees and hips.
Lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position in a controlled manner.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一只手握住哑铃，正握。
稍微弯曲膝盖，臀部向前转动，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
将哑铃向地面放低，使其靠近身体。
爆发性伸展臀部、膝盖和脚踝，将哑铃沿直线向上推。
当哑铃到达肩膀高度时，快速旋转你的手并将其击打过头顶，充分伸展你的手臂。
将哑铃举过头顶，膝盖和臀部稍微弯曲。
以受控的方式将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

3952.description: Step into a lunge and drive the knee high to raise the heart rate.
instructions: Stand tall.
Step forward into a lunge.
Push off and drive the back knee up high.
Step back and repeat on the other side.
Keep your pace steady for 30-60 seconds.

4016.description: A shrug with a barbell while seated. It builds the upper traps.
instructions: Sit upright holding the barbell at thigh level.
Keep your arms straight.
Lift your shoulders to your ears.
Pause.
Lower slowly.

4080.description: Kneeling crunch against a band anchored overhead. It trains the abs with steady resistance.
instructions: Anchor the band high and kneel facing it, holding the ends beside your head.
Keep your hips still.
Crunch your ribs toward your hips.
Pause and squeeze your abs.
Return slowly.

4144.description: Hinge forward and pull a band down toward your hips, like a lat pulldown from a bent over position. It trains the lats and the muscles between your shoulder blades.
instructions: Anchor the band high and hold it with both hands, arms extended.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and soft knees.
Pull the band down toward your hips, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom for a moment.
Let the band rise slowly until your arms are straight again.
Keep your torso still and your neck neutral.

4208.description: Jump up onto a box with both feet and step or drop down with one. It builds explosive leg power and single-leg control.
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing your arms and jump up, landing softly on the box with both feet.
Stand tall on top of the box.
Step down with one leg first, then the other.
Reset and repeat, alternating the leading leg.
Land quietly with bent knees.

4336.description: A biceps curl on a plate-loaded lever machine that guides the path. It builds the front of the upper arm.
instructions: Adjust the seat so your elbows line up with the machine pivot.
Grip the handles with palms up.
Curl the handles toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.

4400.description: A step-up on a bench or box while holding a kettlebell, working the quads and glutes one leg at a time.
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box or bench holding a kettlebell at your chest or by your side.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Press through that heel to stand tall on top.
Lower back down slowly with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

4464.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the shin (tibialis anterior). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your shin (tibialis anterior) while kneeling or sitting on the floor.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4528.description: Walking while carrying a heavy kettlebell in each hand. It builds grip, posture and core stability.
instructions: Pick up a kettlebell in each hand and stand tall.
Pull your shoulders back and brace your core.
Walk forward in controlled steps.
Keep the kettlebells from swinging.
Walk for a set distance or time, then set them down carefully.

4592.description: A curved rear-hand punch thrown to a partner's pad, using torso rotation for power.
instructions: Face your partner, who holds a pad out to the side.
Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Bend your right elbow and rotate your hips and torso.
Swing the fist in an arc into the pad.
Pivot your rear foot as you turn.
Return to your guard.

4720.description: A kneeling crunch against band resistance. It strengthens the abs through a loaded crunch.
instructions: Anchor the band overhead and kneel facing it.
Hold the band beside your head.
Crunch down, bringing your elbows toward your thighs.
Round your spine and tighten your abs.
Return slowly and repeat.

4784.description: A seated pull-up on a low bar. It reduces the load compared with a full pull-up, which is good for building strength.
instructions: Set a bar low and sit beneath it.
Grab it with an overhand grip, a little wider than your shoulders.
Extend your legs in front with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower under control.

4848.description: A front squat starting from pins in a rack, removing the stretch reflex. It builds strength out of the bottom.
instructions: Set pins at the bottom depth and place the bar on them.
Get under the bar in a front rack position.
Brace and drive up to stand.
Lower back to the pins under control.
Pause and reset between reps.

4912.description: A hamstring curl with the heels in rings, second variation. It builds hamstrings and glutes with an unstable setup.
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels in the rings.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Pull the rings toward your glutes by bending the knees.
Pause and squeeze the hamstrings.
Extend your legs slowly back out.
Keep your hips high throughout.

4976.description: A mountain climber with a jump between the feet. It raises your heart rate and works the core.
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Switch legs with a small jump.
Keep your hips low.
Maintain a fast, steady pace.
Rest when your form slips.

5040.description: Lying face down, arms form an A shape and lift. It strengthens the upper back and shoulder blade muscles.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms out at about 45 degrees, palms down.
Rest your forehead lightly or look at the floor.
Lift your arms and chest slightly while squeezing your shoulder blades.
Hold for a second.
Lower with control and repeat.

5232.description: A deadlift position held into a bent-over row. It trains your back and hamstrings together.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and soft knees.
Row the dumbbells toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower the weights slowly and stand back up.

5680.description: A mountain climber where the knees drive toward the elbows on the side. It raises your heart rate and works the obliques and hips.
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Drive one knee out toward the same-side elbow.
Return that foot and switch quickly to the other leg.
Keep your hips low and your core tight.
Continue at a brisk pace for the set time.

6000.description: A bridge on one leg with the other leg stretched out, to strengthen the glutes and hamstrings and test hip stability.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Extend your left leg straight out.
Drive through your right heel to lift your hips.
Keep your hips level.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps and switch legs.

6064.description: A seated concentration curl with an overhand grip. It targets the forearms and brachialis.
instructions: Sit with feet wide, holding a bottle with an overhand grip, elbow resting on your inner thigh.
Let your arm hang straight.
Curl the bottle up without bending your wrist.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

6512.description: A low cable row that emphasises the shoulder blade, training the muscles between and around it.
instructions: Set a cable low and hold the handle with one hand.
Hinge slightly forward with a flat back.
Pull your shoulder blade back toward your spine.
Squeeze for a second.
Return slowly, then switch arms.

6768.description: The same side-lying scalene release as seen from the side. A ball at the neck eases the muscles with light pressure.
instructions: Lie on your side with a small ball under the side of your neck.
Support your head so your neck stays neutral.
Relax your shoulder.
Gently move your head to roll over the ball.
Keep the pressure light.
Do 30-60 seconds, then switch sides.

7216.description: A wall-supported raise of the opposite arm and leg. It trains balance and lower back stability.
instructions: Stand facing a wall in a bent over position with your hands on it.
Brace your core.
Lift one arm and the opposite leg at the same time.
Hold for a second without twisting.
Lower and repeat on the other side.

8880.description: A quick punch thrown against cable resistance builds fast, explosive pushing power. It also trains the trunk to resist twisting.
instructions: Stand facing away from the cable with the handle at chest height in one hand.
Take a staggered stance and keep your core tight.
Punch the handle forward quickly, rotating your hips a little.
Stop just before your elbow locks out.
Return the hand with control to your chin.
Do all reps, then switch arms.

10032.description: A simple thumb movement where you lift the thumb away from the palm to improve hand mobility.
instructions: Rest your hand on a table with the palm facing up.
Keep your fingers relaxed and straight.
Slowly move your thumb away from your palm.
Pause at the end of the range.
Return slowly to the start.
Do 10-15 reps, then switch hands.

10096.description: A combo move: a rear lunge followed by a single-arm press as you stand. It works legs and shoulders together.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at one shoulder and stand tall.
Step one leg back into a lunge.
Push through the front foot to stand up.
As you rise, press the dumbbell overhead.
Lower it to your shoulder and repeat.
Switch arms or legs each set.

10160.description: A drop from a box with a soft two foot landing that trains landing control and leg power.
instructions: Stand on a sturdy box with your toes near the edge.
Step off the box, do not jump.
Land on both feet at the same time with soft, bent knees.
Sink into a quarter squat to absorb the impact and hold the landing.
Step back up and repeat. Keep your knees in line with your toes.

10672.description: A one-arm seated press on a lever machine. It builds the chest on each side and trains the core to resist twisting.
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad and grip one handle.
Brace your core and keep your torso square.
Press the handle forward in a smooth line.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Keep your shoulder down.
Do the reps, then switch arms.

10736.description: A gentle bending drill that works the back and hips. The motion loosens your spine and posterior chain.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands behind your head.
Soften your knees.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Nod your head slightly and return to standing.
Move at a smooth pace.
Keep your neck relaxed.

10864.description: Stepping up onto a tall box. It builds the quads and glutes.
instructions: Stand facing a high box.
Place one foot fully on top.
Drive through that heel to stand up.
Bring the other foot up.
Step down with control.
Switch leading legs.

10928.description: A towel slide up the wall that works the muscle along the ribs. It supports healthy shoulder blade motion.
instructions: Stand facing a wall with a towel under your forearm on the wall.
Keep your elbow bent and your body upright.
Slide your arm upward along the wall.
Reach the top without shrugging.
Slide back down slowly and switch arms.

11056.description: A seated machine move where you pull your shoulder blades together. It strengthens the muscles between your shoulder blades.
instructions: Sit with your chest against the pad and grab the handles with straight arms.
Let your shoulder blades spread forward slightly.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together without bending your elbows.
Hold the squeeze for a second.
Return slowly to the start.

11568.description: A Bulgarian split squat on a Smith machine with the front foot raised, giving extra depth for quads and glutes.
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and stand with the front foot on a low plate or step.
Place the rear foot on a bench behind you.
Lower straight down until the front thigh is about parallel or deeper.
Keep your torso upright and the front knee tracking over the toes.
Push through the front heel to stand, then switch legs.

0048.description: An incline press with a reverse grip, loading the upper chest and triceps.
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Lie back on the bench and grasp the barbell with a reverse grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the barbell and lower it towards your upper chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the barbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
仰卧在长凳上，反握抓住杠铃，双手距离略宽于肩宽。
松开杠铃并将其向上胸部降低，保持肘部内收。
在底部停顿片刻，然后将杠铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0112.description: A standing torso twist with the bar on your shoulders. Works the obliques.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell in front of your chest with both hands, palms facing down.
Engage your core and keep your back straight throughout the exercise.
Slowly twist your torso to the right, pivoting on your feet and hips, while keeping your lower body stable.
Pause for a moment at the end of the twist, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat the twist to the left side.
Continue alternating twists for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住杠铃于胸前，掌心朝下。
在整个练习过程中启动你的核心并保持背部挺直。
慢慢地将躯干向右扭转，以脚和臀部为轴，同时保持下半身稳定。
扭转结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
向左侧重复扭转。
继续交替扭转所需的重复次数。

0176.description: Kneeling cable triceps extension with a rope. Your elbows stay put while the forearms extend, which keeps the work on the triceps.
instructions: Attach a rope handle to a high pulley and kneel down facing the cable machine.
Grasp the rope with a neutral grip (palms facing each other) and bring your hands to the sides of your head.
Keep your elbows close to your head and your upper arms stationary throughout the exercise.
Extend your forearms by contracting your triceps until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment, then slowly return to the starting position by bending your elbows.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将绳索手柄连接到高滑轮上，面向绳索机跪下。
以中立握法（手掌相对）抓住绳子，并将双手放在头的两侧。
在整个练习过程中，保持肘部靠近头部，上臂保持静止。
通过收缩三头肌来伸展前臂，直到手臂完全伸展。
暂停片刻，然后弯曲肘部慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0240.description: Lying face down on a bench, you raise the cable handles out to the sides. It works the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: Attach a D-handle to a low pulley cable machine and lie face down on a flat bench.
Grasp the D-handle with each hand, palms facing down, and extend your arms straight out in front of you.
Keeping your arms straight, raise them out to the sides until they are parallel to the floor.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将 D 形手柄连接到低滑轮缆绳机上，并面朝下躺在平凳上。
每只手握住 D 形手柄，手掌朝下，并将双臂伸直至前方。
保持手臂伸直，将它们向两侧举起，直到与地板平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0304.description: A shrug performed lying face down on a bench. Pulling the shoulders up trains the traps without the lower back.
instructions: Set up a decline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Lie face down on the bench with your chest and stomach resting on it.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing each other and your arms fully extended.
Keeping your arms straight, raise your shoulders as high as possible while squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Hold the contraction for a brief pause, then lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 设置一个 45 度角的下斜凳。
脸朝下躺在长凳上，胸部和腹部靠在长凳上。
每只手握住一个哑铃，手掌相对，双臂完全伸展。
保持手臂伸直，尽可能高地抬高肩膀，同时将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
保持收缩短暂停顿，然后将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0368.description: Forearms over a bench with palms down, you lift the dumbbells with your wrists. It strengthens the top of the forearms.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing down.
Rest your forearms on the bench, allowing your wrists to hang off the edge.
Slowly curl your wrists upward, bringing the dumbbells towards your body.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，双手各握一个哑铃，掌心朝下。
将前臂放在长凳上，让手腕悬在长凳边缘。
慢慢向上弯曲手腕，将哑铃拉向身体。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0432.description: With soft knees, you lower dumbbells down your legs and stand back up. It trains the hamstrings, glutes and lower back.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, hinge at the hips and lower the dumbbells towards the ground, allowing a slight bend in your knees.
Lower the dumbbells until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then squeeze your glutes and push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，正握。
保持背部挺直，核心收紧，铰接臀部并将哑铃向地面降低，让膝盖稍微弯曲。
降低哑铃，直到感觉到腿筋拉伸，然后挤压臀肌并通过脚后跟推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0496.description: Lying or kneeling with your feet anchored on a bench, you bend the knees and bring your body upright. It strongly works the hamstrings.
instructions: Lie face down on a bench with your hips at the edge and your legs extended straight behind you.
Hold onto the bench for support.
Keeping your upper body still, bend your knees and curl your legs towards your glutes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly extend your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 脸朝下躺在长凳上，臀部位于边缘，双腿伸直在身后。
抓住长凳以获得支撑。
保持上半身不动，弯曲膝盖并将双腿向臀部弯曲。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将双腿伸展回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0560.description: A kneeling lunge stretch that opens the front of the hip and thigh. Good after sitting or leg training.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front of you.
Place a pad under your back knee if needed.
Tuck your pelvis and squeeze the glute of the back leg.
Shift your hips gently forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

0624.description: With your back against a wall, you hold a seated position with knees bent to 90 degrees. Builds endurance in the quads and glutes.
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet hip-width apart.
Slowly slide your back down the wall until your knees are bent at a 90-degree angle.
Lift your right foot off the ground and bring your knee towards your chest.
Lower your right foot back down and lift your left foot off the ground, bringing your knee towards your chest.
Continue alternating between lifting your right and left foot for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 背靠墙站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
慢慢地将背部滑下墙壁，直到膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
将右脚抬离地面，并将膝盖靠近胸部。
将右脚放低，将左脚抬离地面，将膝盖靠近胸部。
继续交替抬起右脚和左脚，达到所需的重复次数。

0688.description: Hanging from a bar, you pull your shoulder blades down without bending your arms. Builds shoulder control and the lower traps.
instructions: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your arms fully extended.
Retract your shoulder blades by pulling them down and back.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar, focusing on squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先悬挂在引体向上杆上，手掌背向自己，手臂完全伸展。
通过向下拉和向后拉动肩胛骨来缩回肩胛骨。
启动背部肌肉，将身体拉向杠铃杆，重点是将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低身体回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0752.description: On the smith machine, you lift the bar from hip height or lower with a hip hinge. Works the glutes, hamstrings and lower back.
instructions: Set up the smith machine with the bar at hip height.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward.
Bend at the hips and knees, keeping your back straight and chest up, and grip the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and lift the bar by extending your hips and knees, keeping the bar close to your body.
Stand up straight, fully extending your hips and knees.
Lower the bar back down by bending at the hips and knees, maintaining control and keeping your back straight.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将史密斯机设置为与臀部高度相同的杠铃。
双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾稍微向外。
弯曲臀部和膝盖，保持背部挺直，挺胸，正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
伸展臀部和膝盖，调动核心力量并举起杠铃，保持杠铃靠近身体。
站直，充分伸展臀部和膝盖。
通过弯曲臀部和膝盖来降低杠铃，保持控制并保持背部挺直。
重复所需的重复次数。

0816.description: A bodyweight triceps press that lowers the body by bending the elbows, then presses back up. It works the triceps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you, parallel to the ground.
Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your upper arms close to your sides.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将双臂伸直在身前，与地面平行。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低至地面，保持上臂靠近身体两侧。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0880.description: A cable kickback for the glutes with an ankle strap. This is a second version of the move.
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low cable and stand facing the stack.
Hold the frame for support.
Keep your core tight and kick the strapped leg back.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Return slowly, then switch legs after your reps.

0944.description: Sit back into an imaginary chair with arms overhead. It strengthens the thighs and glutes while challenging balance.
instructions: Stand with feet together or hip-width apart.
Bend your knees and send your hips back, keeping your chest lifted.
Raise your arms overhead with palms facing each other.
Keep your knees over your ankles and your tailbone tucked slightly.
Hold for 5 slow breaths, then stand up.
